name: Eastern Cape
description: The Eastern Cape has one of South Africa's highest social grant dependency rates, with over 2.5 million beneficiaries. The province has a large rural population spread across six district municipalities, making mobile SASSA offices essential for reaching remote communities.
srd_challenges: Many rural beneficiaries in the Eastern Cape struggle with smartphone access and internet connectivity. The USSD codes (*120*69277#) and WhatsApp line (082 046 8553) are the most practical status check methods for this province.
payment_collection: SASSA grants can be collected at Post Office branches, Pick n Pay, Boxer, Shoprite, and Spar stores across all Eastern Cape districts. Postbank Black Card holders can use any ATM.

name: Free State
description: The Free State serves approximately 700,000 social grant beneficiaries across four district municipalities. The province has a mix of urban centres (Bloemfontein, Welkom) and extensive farming communities.
srd_challenges: Beneficiaries in farming areas often travel long distances to SASSA offices. The Moya App and WhatsApp are recommended for status checks to avoid unnecessary travel.
payment_collection: Post Office branches are the primary collection points. Checkers, Shoprite, and Pick n Pay stores across the Free State also offer cash collection for SRD grant recipients.

name: Gauteng
description: Gauteng is South Africa's most populous province with over 3.2 million social grant beneficiaries. The province has the highest concentration of SASSA offices, digital infrastructure, and alternative payment points.
srd_challenges: High volumes cause longer processing times during peak periods. Beneficiaries should apply early in the month and use the online portal for fastest results. Scam websites are prevalent in Gauteng — always verify URLs end in .gov.za.
payment_collection: All major retailers participate in cash collection: Pick n Pay, Shoprite, Boxer, Spar, and Checkers. Postbank Black Card holders can use any ATM. Gauteng has the highest density of collection points in the country.

name: KwaZulu-Natal
description: KwaZulu-Natal has South Africa's largest social grant beneficiary population at over 3.8 million recipients. The province spans urban centres (Durban, Pietermaritzburg), extensive rural areas, and the Zululand region.
srd_challenges: Flooding in coastal areas can disrupt SASSA office operations during summer months. Rural beneficiaries in uMkhanyakude and Zululand districts often rely on mobile SASSA units.

main_offices.address: Cnr Kruger & West Street, Richards Bay

payment_collection: Post Office branches and retailer collection points available in all districts. Mobile collection units serve deep rural areas in northern KZN. Cardholders can use SASSA ATMs in Durban and Pietermaritzburg.

name: Limpopo
description: Limpopo serves over 2.1 million grant recipients across five district municipalities. The province is predominantly rural with many beneficiaries in remote villages, particularly in the Vhembe and Sekhukhune districts.
srd_challenges: Limited internet access in rural areas makes USSD codes and WhatsApp the preferred status check methods. Many beneficiaries travel to urban centres on pay days to collect grants.
payment_collection: Post Office branches are the main collection points. Mobile SASSA pay points operate in remote villages on scheduled dates. Pick n Pay and Shoprite in town centres offer cash collection.

name: Mpumalanga
description: Mpumalanga serves approximately 900,000 grant beneficiaries across three district municipalities. The province includes urban centres (Mbombela, Witbank, Secunda) and extensive rural areas along the Mozambique border.
srd_challenges: Cross-border applicants (Mozambique/Swaziland) require special permit documentation. Beneficiaries in rural Nkomazi and Bushbuckridge areas rely on mobile SASSA units.

main_offices.address: Cnr FW De Klerk & Syfer Road, Secunda

payment_collection: Post Office branches available in all district towns. Boxer and Shoprite stores offer cash collection in urban centres. Mobile pay points serve deep rural areas on scheduled dates.

name: North West
description: North West province serves approximately 1.1 million social grant beneficiaries across four district municipalities. The province includes mining communities, farming areas, and the entertainment hub of Rustenburg.
srd_challenges: Mining employees who lose their jobs often face delays in SRD approval because SASSA systems may show active UIF records. Beneficiaries should ensure UIF deregistration before applying for SRD.

main_offices.address: Cnr University & Albert Luthuli Drive, Mahikeng
Cnr Margaretha & CR Swart Street, Klerksdorp

payment_collection: Post Office branches in all district towns. Boxer, Shoprite, and Pick n Pay available in urban centres. Mobile pay points serve farming communities.

name: Northern Cape
description: The Northern Cape is South Africa's largest province by area but smallest by population, serving approximately 350,000 grant beneficiaries. The vast distances between towns make SASSA access challenging for many residents.
srd_challenges: Extreme distances between SASSA offices mean beneficiaries may travel 200km+ for in-person services. Online and WhatsApp methods are strongly recommended for status checks and appeals.
payment_collection: Post Office branches are the primary collection points. Mobile SASSA pay points visit remote towns on scheduled dates. Limited retailer participation in deep rural areas.

name: Western Cape
description: The Western Cape serves approximately 1.5 million social grant beneficiaries. The province has good digital infrastructure but faces challenges with seasonal farm worker grant applications.
srd_challenges: Seasonal farm workers who earn above R624 during harvest months are often declined for those months but should continue applying. The SRD portal is the most reliable method in the Western Cape due to good internet penetration.
payment_collection: All major retailers participate in the Western Cape. Post Office branches are well-distributed. Cash Send collection at Pick n Pay and Boxer available for SRD recipients without bank accounts.
